summary: Homecoming weekend brings Missouri State football against New Mexico State on Saturday, plus the Springfield Symphony's Route 66 concert, the Downtown Holiday Open House and an Honoring Veterans Powwow. Friday has the Nutcracker at the Gillioz, Pressure Point Fest at the Shrine Mosque and free Stargazing and S'mores at Finley Farms.
